# Anaerobes

> *Why does one trait, oxygen sensitivity, define a whole group of unrelated bacteria?*

::: {.callout-note}
## In preparation
The layout will match that of [*Gram-positive cocci*](gram-positive-cocci.qmd). The plan:
:::

| Part of the chapter | Plan |
|---|---|
| The group in one sentence | Bacteria poisoned by oxygen that dominate the body's oxygen-poor places and cause harm where tissue loses its blood supply |
| Sorting key | Gram-positive or Gram-negative; spores or not; where in the body they live |
| Main organisms | *Bacteroides fragilis* (colon, capsule, abscess), *Clostridium perfringens* (dead tissue, toxins) |
| Supporting organisms | *Fusobacterium*, *Prevotella*, *Cutibacterium acnes* |
| Later in the course | Abdominal, dental and soft-tissue infections in the organ blocks |
